items.title: Pay invoice for occupational therapy sessions
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Private invoice, payer is in NW, so §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB apply with NW public holidays. Start of period: invoice date 2026-11-18 (day of the event, not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Period is 21 days, counted from 2026-11-19. November has 30 days: from 19 Nov to 30 Nov inclusive = 12 days; remaining 21-12 = 9 days fall in December, i.e. up to and including 9 December. So day 21 of the period is 2026-12-09. That date is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
